◊Legal Disclaimers

Accessories: Accessories are sold separately and are subject to availability. Compatibility varies by model and generation. USB-C to Apple Pencil Adapter is required to work with iPad (A16).

Apple Intelligence and Siri AI: Apple Intelligence is available with Siri and device language set to Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish or Vietnamese. Some features may not be available in all regions or languages. Some devices may not be available in all regions. Siri AI is available in beta in iPadOS 27 and requires an Apple Intelligence–enabled device set to a supported language. Available in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish to start. Siri AI will not be initially available in the EU on iPadOS. Siri AI is not available for users under 13. Certain Apple Intelligence features that rely on server-side models are subject to daily usage limits, including but not limited to Siri AI, Intelligent Photo Editing Tools, Image Playground and AFM 3 Cloud models in Shortcuts. Daily limits may vary by feature, request complexity, system demand, system policies and other factors. Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future. Use of these features is subject to the Apple Intelligence Terms and Conditions. Learn more at support.apple.com/en-in/148587.

Apps: Apps are available on the App Store. Title availability is subject to change. Procreate Dreams is available for purchase on the App Store.

CPU and GPU Performance: Compared with iPad mini (A17 Pro). Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production iPad mini (A20 Pro) and production iPad mini (A17 Pro) units. CPU performance based on iPad mini (A20 Pro) with 6-core CPU. Tested with Affinity Photo 2 v2.6.4 using the built-in benchmark version 25000. Performance tests are conducted using specific iPad units and reflect the approximate performance of iPad mini.

Display: The displays have rounded corners. When measured diagonally as a rectangle, the 11″ iPad Pro is 28.22 cm (11.1″), the 11″ iPad Air is 27.59 cm (10.86″) and the 8.5″ iPad mini (A20 Pro) is 21.59 cm (8.5″). Actual viewable area is less.

Fast Charging: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production iPad mini (A20 Pro) units, and USB‑C Charge Cable with Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max (Model A3351) or Apple 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (Model A2571). Requires an outlet that supports up to 1.5A at 100–240V, 50–60Hz. Fast-charge testing conducted with drained iPad mini. Times measured from the appearance of the Apple logo as the unit started up. Charge time varies with settings and environmental factors; actual results will vary.

Feature Availability: Some features may not be available for all countries or all areas. See apple.com/in/ios/feature-availability for complete list.

iCloud+: Subscription is required. The Apple TV subscription included with iCloud+ does not include third-party branded subscription services or content available for rental or purchase in the Apple TV app. Some iCloud features require a Wi-Fi connection and are not available in all countries or regions. Access to some services is limited to 10 devices.

5G: Data plan is required. 5G is available in selected markets and through selected carriers. Speeds vary based on site conditions and carrier. For details on 5G support, contact your carrier and see apple.com/in/ipad/cellular.

Power and Battery: Battery life varies by use and settings. See apple.com/in/batteries for more information.

Size and Weight: Size and weight vary by conﬁguration and manufacturing process.

Storage Capacity: Actual formatted capacity is less and varies due to many factors. Storage capacity is subject to change based on software version, settings and iPad model. 1GB = 1 billion bytes; 1TB = 1 trillion bytes.

Thinner and Lighter: Compared with the previous generation.

Water and Dust Resistance: iPad mini (A20 Pro) is splash, water and dust resistant, and was tested under controlled laboratory conditions with a rating of IP67 under IEC standard 60529 (maximum depth of 1 metre up to 30 minutes). Splash, water and dust resistance are not permanent conditions. Resistance might decrease as a result of normal wear. Do not attempt to charge a wet iPad; refer to the user guide for cleaning and drying instructions. Liquid damage is not covered under warranty.

Wi-Fi 7: Wi-Fi 7 is available in countries and regions where supported.
